title: Attestation Orchestrator: Lite Evidence Pack + Pricing Trigger Pilot
creator: Nora Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers request rapid, lightweight security attestations for procurement cycles. Current SIG/CAIQ full evidence bundles require heavy manual work and delay contract close. Opportunity: ship a lightweight, self-service "Lite Evidence Pack" that bundles a curated subset of SIG/CAIQ answers, cryptographically-signed customer attestations, and a clear pricing trigger that can be invoked during checkout or sales negotiation. Goals: 1) reduce median time-to-legal-signature for mid-market customers from 14 to <=7 days for standard requests; 2) measure revenue uplift and conversion delta when attaching Lite packs at $X price or as a usage-based credit; 3) minimize engineering and SE labor per request by automating answer assembly, signature generation, and evidence fingerprinting. Scope: product + legal + security + solutions. Excludes full CAIQ automation for regulated RFPs (follow-on work). Success metrics: conversion rate lift for deals that accept Lite pack, number of manual evidence hours reduced, and NPS for onboarding experience. Deliverables: product checkout flow with attestation add-on, automated evidence assembler (backend lambda + templating), signed attestations (HSM-backed), admin UI for generating on-demand packs, pricing experiment matrix, instrumentation dashboards and conversion funnel measurement.
